User has a weekly language-exchange class at a local language school with Colombian tutor Juan on Wednesday evenings. They meet Wednesday evening; Juan helps with Spanish pronunciation and grammar, while user helps with English vocabulary. User wants reminders about this recurring appointment.

User is planning a trip to Colombia and wants Spanish travel phrases, including shopping vocabulary. They corrected an earlier mistake: they meet tutor **Maria this Thursday** (not Wednesday, and not Juan’s regular class). They may want help preparing for this session.

Trip interests: visiting Bogotá’s Gold Museum (Museo del Oro), Plaza de Bolívar, surrounding La Candelaria streets, cafes/restaurants, Spanish-conquest history, and nearby landmarks such as Museo de la Independencia, Casa de la Moneda, Teatro Colón, Iglesia de San Francisco, Plaza del Chorro de Quevedo, and Calle del Embudo. User plans to grab a snack at a café around Plaza de Bolívar before exploring the surrounding streets.
